name: Phase Striker (Scout Archetype)
body:
Scouts are already masters of mobility, these scouts take it even further, flitting from place to place by teleporting.

Phase Shift (Su)

At 1st level, a phase striker gains the ability to move short distances by teleportation. When taking a five foot step or standing from the prone the phase striker may teleport to do so as long as they have 1 grit point. This teleportation takes the same action that would normally be used to take a five foot step or stand from prone and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

This ability replaces trapfinding.

Dimensional Skirmisher (Ex)

At 4th level, as long as the phase striker has at least 1 grit point, teleporting is considered movement for abilities and feats that require or have special effects for movement such as the skirmish deed and Spring Attack.

This ability replaces trackless step.

Stride Through Space (Sp)

At 6th level, as a standard action the phase striker may spend 1 grit point to cast dimension door as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to their class level. At 10th level, the phase striker may spend 3 grit points to use this spell-like ability as a swift action. This ability replaces unhindered steps and astounding grit.

The following deeds replace deeds normally gained by the scout.

Phase Step (Su)

At 3rd level, as long as the phase striker has at least 1 grit point when they make a successful Acrobatics check to avoid attacks of opportunity or the effects of difficult terrain, they may choose to teleport instead of moving physically and may teleport a distance up to their full base movement speed. For example, normally to avoid an attack of opportunity for moving through a threatened square a character must make an Acrobatics check against a DC equal to the threatening creature’s CMD and is limited to moving at half speed. With this ability the phase striker still makes the Acrobatics check but instead teleports a distance up to their base movement speed in any direction.

This deed replaces the kip up deed normally gained at 3rd level.

Slip Through The Cracks (Su)

Starting with 15th level, as long as the phase striker has at least 2 grit points they are unaffected by any effect which would prevent teleportation such as dimensional anchor and their teleportation cannot be redirected with teleport trap or similar effects unless the caster level of these effects is equal to or higher than five plus the phase striker’s class level.

This deed replaces the unbound deed normally gained at 15th level.
